from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Callable, Hashable

class TTLCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int, default_ttl: float, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic) -> None:
        if not isinstance(capacity, int) or isinstance(capacity, bool) or capacity < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be an int >= 1")
        if not self._is_valid_ttl(default_ttl):
            raise ValueError("default_ttl must be > 0")
        if not callable(clock):
            raise TypeError("clock must be callable")
        self._capacity = capacity
        self._default_ttl = default_ttl
        self._clock = clock
        self._entries = OrderedDict()

    @staticmethod
    def _is_valid_ttl(ttl: Any) -> bool:
        if isinstance(ttl, bool) or not isinstance(ttl, (int, float)):
            return False
        return ttl > 0

    def _purge_expired(self, now: float) -> None:
        # Remove all entries whose expiry boundary has been reached.
        expired = [key for key, (_, expires_at) in self._entries.items() if now >= expires_at]
        for key in expired:
            del self._entries[key]

    def _purge_and_make_space(self, now: float) -> None:
        self._purge_expired(now)
        if len(self._entries) >= self._capacity:
            self._entries.popitem(last=False)

    def put(self, key: Hashable, value: Any, ttl: float | None = None) -> None:
        if ttl is None:
            entry_ttl = self._default_ttl
        elif not self._is_valid_ttl(ttl):
            raise ValueError("ttl must be > 0")
        else:
            entry_ttl = ttl

        now = self._clock()
        expires_at = now + entry_ttl

        if key in self._entries:
            _, current_expires_at = self._entries[key]
            if now < current_expires_at:
                self._entries[key] = (value, expires_at)
                self._entries.move_to_end(key)
                return
            del self._entries[key]

        self._purge_and_make_space(now)
        self._entries[key] = (value, expires_at)

    def get(self, key: Hashable, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        now = self._clock()
        entry = self._entries.get(key)
        if entry is not None:
            value, expires_at = entry
            if now < expires_at:
                self._entries.move_to_end(key)
                return value
            del self._entries[key]
        return default

    def peek(self, key: Hashable, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        now = self._clock()
        entry = self._entries.get(key)
        if entry is not None:
            value, expires_at = entry
            if now < expires_at:
                return value
            del self._entries[key]
        return default

    def delete(self, key: Hashable) -> bool:
        now = self._clock()
        entry = self._entries.get(key)
        if entry is not None:
            _, expires_at = entry
            live = now < expires_at
            del self._entries[key]
            return live
        return False

    def keys(self) -> list[Hashable]:
        self._purge_expired(self._clock())
        return list(self._entries.keys())

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        self._purge_expired(self._clock())
        return len(self._entries)

    def __contains__(self, key: Hashable) -> bool:
        now = self._clock()
        entry = self._entries.get(key)
        if entry is not None:
            _, expires_at = entry
            if now < expires_at:
                return True
            del self._entries[key]
        return False
